introduction.definition: A vibration monitoring system measures machine vibration continuously: accelerometers on bearing housings (horizontal, vertical, axial), proximity probes measuring shaft movement in oil-film bearings, and a keyphasor for phase. A monitor rack compares readings with alert and trip limits and feeds trends to the control system.
applications: Pumps, fans and motors in process plants

pressure.title: Severity zones guide action
pressure.description: Casing vibration (velocity, mm/s RMS, 10–1000 Hz) is judged against ISO 20816 zones A (new) → B (unrestricted) → C (limited time) → D (damage likely); shaft displacement from proximity probes (µm pk-pk) is used on oil-film bearing machines. Trends and spectra reveal causes: 1× running speed — unbalance; 2× and axial — misalignment; bearing defect frequencies (BPFO / BPFI) — rolling bearing damage; sub-synchronous — oil whirl. The rack raises alerts and trips per API 670 logic (voting, delays).

video_tutorials.title: Vibration Monitoring System — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Vibration Monitoring System.

A vibration monitoring system measures machine vibration continuously: accelerometers on bearing housings (horizontal, vertical, axial), proximity probes measuring shaft movement in oil-film bearings, and a keyphasor for phase.
A monitor rack compares readings with alert and trip limits and feeds trends to the control system.
Typical applications include critical turbomachinery protection (API 670); pumps, fans and motors in process plants.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Shaft & Coupling with Keyphasor Notch (once-per-turn reference).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Vibration Monitoring System works.
Accelerometers sense casing vibration.
Proximity probes sense shaft motion.
Signals go to the rack.
Alerts and trips protect the machine.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

Casing vibration (velocity, mm/s RMS, 10–1000 Hz) is judged against ISO 20816 zones A (new) → B (unrestricted) → C (limited time) → D (damage likely); shaft displacement from proximity probes (µm pk-pk) is used on oil-film bearing machines.

video_tutorials.title: Vibration Monitoring System — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Vibration Monitoring System.
Review alarms and trends.
Check sensor mounting and gap voltages.
Loop-test channels and trips.
Watch for false trip: trip without real vibration. Common cause: loose connector, single-channel logic.
Watch for sensor detached: flat or noisy signal. Common cause: mounting failure.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
